info.title: PeFix
info.description: Diagnose and fix PE header portability for .NET assemblies.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Diagnose or fix managed assembly PE header portability issues.

Exit codes:
  0  No issues
  1  Issues found (gate triggered or files refused)
  2  Usage error
  4  IO error

options.name: --fix
options.description: Attempt a safe PE header fix. [default: False]

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 1 when the result meets or exceeds the given severity.

options.name: --fail-on-conflict
options.description: Exit with code 1 when version conflicts are detected in a directory scan. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report fixes without modifying files. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Assembly file or directory to inspect.
